tagline: Micro-cap defence-linked civil contractor now in real financial distress: a formal loan default disclosed, promoter pledge at 75%, and a marquee Rs 187 Cr jetty contract terminated for delays
business_overview: RKEC Projects is a civil construction contractor focused on industrial, marine, and bridge projects, holding Super Special Class registered contractor status with the Ministry of Defence, which gives it unlimited tendering capability on defense-related civil works.

fundamentals_narrative: What looked like a decent micro-cap quality profile (ROCE 15.5%, 20% revenue growth) in the prior pass has been overtaken by a genuine financial-distress episode. FY26 revenue collapsed 57% YoY to ~Rs180 Cr with an operating loss (OPM -11%) and ROE -19.4%; the company then lost a Rs186.67 Cr Mumbai jetty EPC contract to termination over delays in April 2026 (FY27 Q1), and by 31-Jul-2026 formally disclosed a loan default of Rs55.90 Cr principal plus Rs7.52 Cr interest overdue against ~Rs212 Cr of FY25 borrowings. Promoter holding fell from 66.51% to 57.74% (Mar->Jun 2026) while pledge on the remaining stake rose to 75.2% - a classic promoter-distress signature. The Ministry of Defence Super Special Class registration (unlimited tendering) is still real, but with bank-guarantee capacity now almost certainly impaired by the default, it is optionality the company likely cannot use until the balance sheet is repaired. The stock trades at 0.31x book, but that is distress pricing, not cheapness.

Score 2.0 -> thesis_fit neither, no exception granted given the concurrent HIGH CAUTION red flag.
